root_cause_classification.mechanism: Trend/Order facts require a contiguous admitted history; a 61-session exact resource window is invalidated for T when non-admitted sessions or coordinate/listing resets break the contiguous segment. The frozen 32-resource cell therefore did not yield 24 complete PRE_STAR/MAIN cases even after all eight same-cell fallbacks.
root_cause_classification.claim_ceiling: This closeout demonstrates only that the frozen P013-D sample/admission design could not produce its preregistered complete-case denominator. It does not reject the P012 atomic candidate surfaces, gates, Era x Board resource model, or the wider A-share data population.

exposure_accounting.conservative_future_overlap_policy: Until an immutable exact exposure reconstruction proves a narrower set, treat all 256 exact P013-D identity-windows as L3_THRESHOLD_OR_MODEL_BASIS_CONSUMED for future overlapping-window exclusion.
exposure_accounting.future_same_identity_disjoint_window_reu: allowed only through a new preregistered development batch and never counted as independent identity evidence

successor.principle: Freeze a deterministic identity/window candidate order before reading input readiness, qualify resources using admission/contiguous-history conditions only, then freeze the semantic sample before any Structure morphology, threshold, reference or candidate output is read.
